newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CEN EURO BOURSES PUSH CESI TO RECORD 1,561.57 PTS.
newsitem.headline: CEN EURO BOURSES PUSH CESI TO RECORD 1,561.57 PTS.

text.p: The CESI Central European Share Index rose to a record of 1,561.57 points on Thursday, up by 31.74 points or 2.07 percent, the Budapest Stock Exchange said on its Reuters page.
The CESI firmed as shares on all the bourses in the index posted gains on Thursday.
The index, which has been published since February 1, reflects trends of 73 shares on the Budapest, Prague, Warsaw, Bratislava and Ljubljana bourses.
The previous high was reached on September 2 last year, at 1,544.70 points.
